title: Quilting Word Search
subtitle: Large Print: 60 Easy-to-Read Puzzles for Quilters, Adults & Seniors
description:
A relaxing break between stitches.

Settle into your favorite chair with 60 large print word search puzzles made for people who love quilting. Every puzzle is built around the words quilters use every day, from fat quarters and flying geese to binding, batting and the quilt shop.

Inside you'll find:

  • 60 themed puzzles: fabrics, classic blocks, notions, star blocks, the four seasons and more
  • Large, bold letters on big 8.5 x 11 inch pages that are easy on the eyes
  • Words run forward and diagonally only, never backwards
  • One puzzle per page, with every answer at the back

A thoughtful gift for quilters, guild friends, grandmothers and retirees. Perfect for birthdays, Mother's Day, Christmas and National Quilting Day.
